hero.title: Your domain. <brand>Your reputation.</brand>
hero.text: Make it harder to send email in your name. Understand SPF and DMARC, identify the gaps, and plan a safer path to protected email.

live.label: Interactive browser demo
live.detail: Illustrative results stay in your browser and do not query live DNS.

beta.detail: Kastro can review actual DNS evidence and scope the right remediation work.

operator.label: Operator-managed rollout
operator.detail: Kastro verifies DNS changes before they go live.

target.label: DMARC target
target.detail: Progress through monitor, quarantine, reject without breaking legitimate mail.

threat.title: Your name should only speak for you.
threat.text: A familiar sender is not always a trusted sender. Explore how an enforced DMARC policy helps receiving mail servers reject impersonation.

workflow.title: Build trust. One record at a time.
workflow.text: The demo explains the messy middle: legacy vendors, SPF lookup limits, report XML, and DNS changes that need careful operational review.

discover.title: Discover
discover.detail: Learn what SPF, DMARC, DKIM, forwarding, and unknown senders mean without connecting an account.

stabilize.title: Stabilize
stabilize.detail: Flatten SPF, remove stale includes, and document every DNS change before it ships.

enforce.title: Enforce
enforce.detail: Advance DMARC from none to quarantine to reject with report-backed confidence.

ladder.title: The enforcement ladder
ladder.detail: Most domains never leave the first rung.

features.title: Complex records. Clear decisions.
features.text: These are capabilities Kastro can scope and deliver for a real domain. They are not activated by the browser demo.

flattening.title: SPF flattening guidance
flattening.detail: Plan how Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, marketing tools, and local senders can stay below the 10-lookup limit.

reporting.title: Readable reporting
reporting.detail: Turn aggregate-report data into sender inventory, pass/fail trends, and a safer enforcement decision.

rollout.title: Provider-aware rollout
rollout.detail: Copy-paste changes tailored for Icelandic DNS providers and reviewed for operational risk.

proof.title: See the why. Before the change.
proof.text: This concept view illustrates how DMARC reports, SPF chains, and DNS records can become actions a business can safely approve.

items.title: Quarantine rollout
items.detail: Start at pct=25 for seven days

pricing.title: Start with clarity. Move with confidence.
pricing.text: The browser demo is free and illustrative. Real DNS review, remediation, and managed implementation are scoped by Kastro.

demo.caption_off: p=none — both messages are delivered. The fake one looks identical.

steps.title: An attacker sends mail “from” your domain
steps.detail: No password needed. SMTP lets anyone write your address in the From field.

steps.title: Your domain has p=none or none at all
steps.detail: Receivers have no instruction to reject unaligned mail, so it sails through.

steps.title: It lands in the inbox, looking legitimate
steps.detail: Your logo, your name, your customer — a convincing invoice or password reset.

footer.title: DMARK closes the gap.
footer.text: We get you to an enforced p=reject safely — without breaking the legitimate mail your business depends on.
